newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania endorses investment scheme for bourse.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania endorses investment scheme for bourse.

text.p: Tanzania's parliament endorsed on Wednesday a scheme to help small investors participate in the stock exchange -- when the long-delayed market finally opens.

Acting Finance Minister Daniel Yona also said a public information campaign would start on February 1 after members of parliament complained they had not been informed well enough about how the exchange worked.

"Most of us don't know what this business of capital markets means particularly after three decades of socialist economic policies," said MP Mudhihir Mudhihir during a parliament session in Tanzania's administrative capital.
Tanzania's Capital Markets and Securities Authority hoped to open a three-tier stock exchange a year ago.
But the exchange was delayed because only a handful of companies have qualified for the exchange's formal tier and the wider commercial and financial environment has been slow to evolve.

The introduction of a bourse is part of a raft of financial reforms including privatisation, exchange liberalisation and civil service reform set up in line with International Monetary Fund (IMF) guidelines.
